channel.title: M&A and ownership: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New m&a and ownership filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: iFamilySC's board supports Welliant's tender offer for its shares at KRW 12,000 per share, running October 23 to November 11, 2026.
SNT Motiv completed its small-scale, no-new-share merger with wholly owned subsidiary SNT Robotics on November 3, 2026.
Korea Steel board backs KISCO Holdings' KRW 13,000-per-share delisting tender offer while leaving the decision to shareholders.
SK Gas completed its small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary SK Advanced on November 4, 2026, issuing no new shares.
Hanwha Machinery & Services Holdings' largest shareholder changed to Kim Dong-seon (75.51% with 6 others) after a tender offer settled on 2026-11-04.
Kim Dong-seon becomes largest shareholder of Hanwha Machinery & Service Holdings with 32.99% of common shares after a tender offer on 2026-11-04.
Sunny Electronics' largest shareholder changed to KX Innovation Co., Ltd. and 6 others, holding 25.38% after an over-the-counter purchase.
KX Innovation became Sunny Electronics' largest shareholder after buying 1,877,873 shares off-market on 2026-11-02; group holds 25.38%.
Hankook Carbon completed its small-scale merger absorbing wholly owned subsidiary Lips Co., Ltd. on November 2, 2026, with no new shares issued.
Hankuk Carbon completed its small-scale merger with wholly owned subsidiary Korea Aviation Technology KAT on November 2, 2026 without issuing new shares.
SJG Sejong completed its small-scale absorption of wholly owned subsidiary SJG Central Research Institute on October 30, 2026, issuing no new shares.
Metalabs completed its small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary Meta S&C on November 1, 2026, issuing no new shares.
Sempio Foods filed a merger securities registration statement to issue 4,208,546 common shares totaling KRW 88.6bn (88,589,893,300원).
